#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables
if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
    echo "Error: .env.test file not found." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "Validating environment variables in .env.test..."

# Read each line, skip comments and empty lines
while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ "$key" =~ ^\s*# ]] && continue
    [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
    
    # Trim whitespace
    key="$(echo "$key" | xargs)"
    value="$(echo "$value" | xargs)"
    
    if [ -z "$value" ]; then
        echo "Error: Required environment variable '$key' is not set." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "✓ $key"

done < .env.test

echo "All environment variables are set. Proceeding with deployment..."

# Send validated config to deployment orchestrator
echo "Sending config to deployment orchestrator..."
CONFIG_CONTENT=$(cat .env.test)
ESCAPED_CONFIG=$(printf '%s' "$CONFIG_CONTENT" | ./bin/jq -aRs @json)
PAYLOAD="{\"config\": $ESCAPED_CONFIG}"

echo "Debug - Payload size: ${#PAYLOAD} characters" >&2

HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -X POST http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d "$PAYLOAD" \
     -o /dev/null)

if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" -ne 200 ]; then
    echo "Failed to send config to orchestrator: HTTP $HTTP_STATUS" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "Config sent successfully (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)."

# Set the name of the archive
ARCHIVE_NAME="release_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).tar.gz"

# Small delay to ensure system stability
sleep 1

echo "Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"

    [[ "$key" =~ ^\s*# ]] && continue
